floor_frame: origin at rug corner R2, x along R1->R2 (toward the right wall), y perpendicular (toward the desk); inches and meters

accuracy.phone_to_phone_offset_at_the_claps_ms: about +-0.5 (the 3 claps and 3 timing methods agree to this)
accuracy.drift_ms_at_the_end: UNMEASURED. There are no claps at the end, so each phone's clock rate against A is unknown. A drift of d ppm adds d * seconds_since_the_claps / 1000 ms of offset: 5 ppm is 2.7 ms (0.9 m) after 9 minutes. Trust the start more than the end.
accuracy.audio_to_position_ms: about +-40 (one video frame is 50 ms; from the hand claps in the video)
accuracy.position: feet midpoint from the offline tracker; about 1.6 cm calibration accuracy, plus detection error
